57:9: D Neţţa id Issadren i umdan iS, issekniyen iberrzen, iwakken a kwen Issuffeɣ si tillas ar tafat. Ih, Ṛebbi, fellawen, d Umɛin Iţḥunun.
57:10: Acu ikwen iuɣen, ur teţseddiqem deg ubrid n Ṛebbi? N Ṛebbi lweṛt n tmurt akked igenwan. Ur taɛdilem ara: wid iseddqen uqbel lɣelb, u nnuɣen, widak, ad aɛlayen, nezzeh, sennig wid iseddqen sin ɣer da, u nnuɣen. Iwaɛɛed asen akw Ṛebbi ṣṣam. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txedmem.
57:11: Win iṛeḍlen i Ṛebbi aṛeṭṭal umɛin, ad as d Irr s lufa, u ines warraz ukyis.
57:12: Asmi ara twaliḍ lmumnin, argaz tameṭṭut, teddun tafat nnsen zdat sen, u yeffus nnsen: "a lxiṛ nnwen, assa, di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen a ţwekkṛem! D wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan".
57:13: Ass ideg ixabiten, argaz tameṭṭut, ad inin i wid iumnen: "arout aɣ, a neddem si tafat nnwen"! A d inin: "uɣalet ar deffir, a d tqelbem tafat"! Ad yili garasen lḥiḍ, s tebburt. Zdaxel d aḥunu, beṛṛa, zdat es: aɛaqeb.
57:14: Ad sen d siwlen: "day ur nella ara yidwen"? Ad inin: "ih! Maca, thewwlem iman nnwen, tekkukram, tcukkem, ɣelḍent kwen lemcihwat, armi d iusa lameṛ n Ṛebbi. Iɣelḍ ikwen af Ṛebbi, uɣellaḍ".
57:15: Assa, ur iţwaṭṭaf feddu segwen, neɣ seg wid ijehlen. Axxam nnwen d times; d neţţat ay d bab nnwen. A tuɣalin tucmiţ!
57:16: Ɛani mačči d lawan, i wid iumnen, ad rgagin wulawen nnsen ar usmekti n Ṛebbi, akked wayen id Issers n tideţ? Ur ţţilin am wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, zik, u tḍul fellasen lmudda. Dɣa qquṛen wulawen nnsen; aṭas degsen d iballaɣen.
57:17: Ecfut ar Ṛebbi Issidir tamurt, deffir tmeţţant is. Niɣ Nbeggen awen d issekniyen, amendeṛ ma a ţfehmem?
57:18: Ih, wid akked tid iţseddiqen, iṛeṭlen i Ṛebbi aṛeṭṭal umɛin, ad asen d Irr s lufa, u nnsen arraz ukyis.
57:19: Wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked imazanen iS, d nitni ay d iḥeqqiyen, u d inagan ar Mass nnsen. Ad awin arraz nnsen akked tafat nnsen. Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nneɣ, widak d at ujajiḥ.
57:20: Cfut ar tameddurt n ddunit d urar kan, d zzhu, d acebbeḥ, d zzux garawen, asuget n wayla akked derya. Am umedya ugeffur. Imɣan is ɛaoben ijehliyen; sinna, ad isliwen, a ten twaliḍ ţţiwṛiɣen; dɣa ad ḥeḍmen. Di laxeṛt, aɛaqeb uqsiḥ akked ssmaḥ sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, akked llza. Tameddurt n ddunit d zzehwa kan iţɣuṛṛun.
57:21: ɣiwlet ar ssmaḥ n Mass nnwen, akked Loennet iwesɛan am tmurt akked igenni, teţţuhegga d i wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked imazanen iS. D wagi ay d lfeḍl n Ṛebbi. Iţţak it i win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl ameqwṛaḥan.
57:22: Ur d tḍeṛṛu twaɣit di tmurt, neɣ deg iman nnwen, siwa ma tura di Tezmamt, uqbel a ţ id Nawi. Ayagi, s tideţ, d ayen isehlen i Ṛebbi.
57:23: Iwakken ur kwen iţɣaḍ wayen tzeglem, ur kwen issefṛaḥ wayen i wen Ifka. Ṛebbi ur Iḥemmel ara yal amzuxi, imnefxi,
57:24: wid iţcuḥḥun, iḥeţţmen ccḥa af medden. Win i iwexxṛen…ihi, Ṛebbi d Asɛay, d Amaɛzuz.
57:25: Nuzen ed imazanen nneɣ, s ubeggen. Nessader ed yidsen Tazmamt akked lmizan, iwakken ad ddun imdanen s lḥeqq. Nessader ed uzzal, degs ḍḍeṛṛ uqsiḥ, akked ubaɣuṛ i medden, iwakken ad Iẓeṛ Ṛebbi anwa ara ifken afus i Neţţa akked imazanen iS, di tbaḍnit. Ih, Ṛebbi d Uohid, d Uzmir.
57:26: Niɣ Nuzen ed Nuḥ akked Ibṛahim. Nerra, si tarwa nnsen, Lambiyya, Tira. Degsen llan wid iţwanhan; aṭas segsen d iballaɣen.
57:27: Sinna, Nesseḍfeṛ ed, deffir sen, imazanen nneɣ. Nesseḍfeṛ ed Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem, Nefka yas Linoil. Nessekcem deg ulawen n wid iddan yides leḥnana akked tiẓeṭ. Taxelwit, ur ţ Nuri fellasen; snulfan ţ id i llza n Ṛebbi. Ur qumen ara yis, akken iwata. Nefka arraz nnsen i wid iumnen segsen. Aṭas, segsen, d iballaɣen.
57:28: A wid iumnen! Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Amnet s Umazan iS. Ad awen Ifk sin imuren seg uḥunu S, ad awen Irr tafat a ţţeddum yis, ad awen Isemmeḥ. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
57:29: Akken ad ẓṛen At Tezmamt, ar ur zmiren acemma di lfeḍl n Ṛebbi. Ih, lfeḍl deg ufus n Ṛebbi; Iţţak it i win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl ameqwṛaḥan.
